text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The review board's... results have arrived!
Everything progressed according to the construction plan, and the facility's
quality is magnificent! In short—this time!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "First, I want to say thanks! This success was only possible because of your help! Thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
However, we're just getting started!
Let's stay vigilant and keep pushing forward!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right!
The next evaluation meeting was late December, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it my all before then
so I can get a great evaluation!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Chest out, stay sharp, and just keep moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 1st Tracen Island Evaluation concluded!
Time to draw up the next construction plan and keep moving forward!
